title: Update how multiple activates work
notes: R1751000: each Activate on a card tracks its uses and cooldown on its own (card.memory activations now {turn, count, abilities}), so a fused Activate no longer shares the kept card's count (amends R1087); clicking Activate on a card with several Activates opens a Discover-style ability picker. 18 cards that fuse, copy or refund activations play differently, found by classify.

player.title: Fused Activates work separately
changes: Each Activate on a card with several now has its own uses and cooldown, so using one leaves the others ready the same turn.
Clicking Activate on a card with several Activates opens a panel to choose which one to use.
